pages.text: It was a frozen winter. Icicles hung in rows from the mill eaves.
"I want just one shiny icicle." Mumu looked up from the yard.
Dodo shook out both wings. "Tap them with a long stick to pick them. I know!"
She lifted a long stick high. Too long! Dodo wobbled.
Whoosh! The stick swept snow from the roof, sending it all down. Dodo vanished into a snow pile.
Out popped Dodo. From head to toe, she was a white snowman.
The icicles still hung, sparkling. "They're holding on tight!" Dodo huffed.
Mumu sat in a sunny part of the yard and waited. Sunlight warmed the sparkling icicles.
Tap, tap, tap! Three icicles dropped into the snow beneath the eaves.
Mumu picked up one and held it high. "Cold and shiny!" Beside him, snowman Dodo held the other two in her beak. "I'm Grandpa Icicle!" Laughter burst out.
